newsitem.title: GREECE: Greece to sell 100bln drachma 5-yr bonds next week.
newsitem.headline: Greece to sell 100bln drachma 5-yr bonds next week.

text.p: Greece will auction 100 billion drachmas worth of 5-year fixed coupon bonds, its first ever, next week, the finance ministry said.

Deputy Finance Minister Nickos Christodoulakis told reporters today that Greece planned to raise about 300 billion drachmas worth of bonds, FRNs and fixed-rate bonds, next week. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
